How Referrals Work

1

Copy Your Link

Get your unique referral link above and share it with friends via WhatsApp, Telegram, or any messaging app.

2

Friend Signs Up

Your friend clicks the link and creates a CampusConnect account using their university email.

3

They Take Action

When your friend posts a listing or completes a transaction, the referral is confirmed.

4

You Both Earn

You receive 500 FCFA in credits. Your friend gets a welcome bonus too!

Reward Tiers

🌱 Starter

1–4 Referrals

Earn 500 FCFA per successful referral. Credits applied to your account instantly.

⭐ Pro

5–14 Referrals

Earn 500 FCFA per referral + a one-time 1,000 FCFA milestone bonus at 5 referrals.

🔥 Champion

15+ Referrals

Earn 700 FCFA per referral (increased rate) and access to exclusive Champion badge.

👑 Legend

50+ Referrals

Earn 1,000 FCFA per referral and get featured on the CampusConnect leaderboard.
